name: Iris
description: Isis is the godess of life, magic, marriage, and fertility. Her name means throne,  marking her as a symbol of royal authority, the greates mother, and a devoted wife.

skills.name: Full Bloom
skills.description: Iris summons a spirit butterfly in an enemy-clustered area, dealing DMG equal to 150% of ATK. Then, it flaps its wings every 2s, dealing DMG equal to 150% of ATK to enemies within range and increasing their DMG taken by 10% for 8s.

upgrades.level2: Enemies within range have their Move SPD reduced by 50%.
upgrades.level3: Increases DMG per hit to 180% ATK.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG dealt to enemies within range by 30%.

skills.name: Rainbow Step
skills.description: When taking DMG, Iris transforms into a rainbow and blinks behind a random ally, increasing nearby allies' ATK SPD by 20% for 10s. This effect can only trigger once every 15s.

skills.name: Dreamscape
skills.description: Summons a spectral butterfly, which slowly illuminates, above the nearest enemy. After 4s, it deals DMG equal to 100% of ATK to that enemy and nearby targets, and stuns them for 3s.

skills.name: Prism Arc
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 250% of ATK to a random enemy and silences the target for 3s.

relic.name: Another Encore
relic.description: Casting Dreamscape targets the 2 nearest enemies.

upgrades.level2: When 2 enemies with Dreamscape get near, the mirage explodes, dealing 200% ATK as bonus DMG.
upgrades.level3: When 2 enemies with Dreamscape get near, the mirage explodes, dealing 240% ATK as bonus DMG.
upgrades.level4: When 2 enemies with Dreamscape get near, the mirage explodes, dealing 280% ATK as bonus DMG.

coreMechanic.summary: CC and AoE ATK buffs. Pairs with Poseidon to amplify AoE DPS. CN: small butterfly, unremarkable support with a consistent use case.

synergyLinks.description: Pairs with Poseidon to amplify grouped AoE DPS output.
